description:
Use this when the user needs the names of the NSE indices that have daily close, PE, PB and dividend-yield history.

Returns every NSE index DalalOS holds daily data for, with its latest date and close. These are the names get_index_valuation, compare_indices and get_stock_vs_index accept. It lists names, not valuations.
name: list_index_valuations
title: Indices with valuation data
